anchors.quote: ## What κ is
Cohen's κ (Cohen, 1960) corrects percent agreement for the agreement two
coders would reach by chance alone, given how often each coder uses each
category. It is 1 for perfect agreement and 0 for agreement no better than
chance. It can be negative, down to −1, when coders agree less often than
chance would predict. Landis and Koch (1977) proposed labels for ranges of κ:
